chunks: The author of this book, may Allah have mercy on him, said:
The report that was narrated is: “There is no bequest for an heir.”

key_terms.وَارِثٍ: An heir who already has an established share in inheritance.
key_terms.وَصِيَّةَ: A bequest or testamentary allocation made before death.

ai.seo_question: Can an heir receive a bequest in Islamic inheritance law?
ai.summary: This report states the legal principle that a bequest is not made in favor of an heir. Its significance is in the law of inheritance and bequests, where the fixed rights of heirs are distinguished from optional testamentary allocations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5443 - The author of this book (may Allah (swt) have mercy on him) said
that another narration states "There is no will for an heir".
